sentences.text: The revision petitioner being collateral security she is equally liable to repay the loan availed by the respondent No.2 from the respondent no.1 Bank.
The section 403 of IPC apples to movable property only .
For this reason,the allegations made in the complaint is not at all attracts the ingredients of section 403.
The alleged offence is criminal breach of trust, for this reason only, the learned Trial Court has opined that the offence punishable U/s.403, 406 does not attracts.
Accordingly, the complaint is returned with a direction to present the same before the jurisdictional Magistrate.
12. In the grounds the revision petitioner urged that the proceedings initiated under the SARFESIA Act is not in accordance with law.
This aspect cannot be questioned before any form except DRT.
The attachment is made in accordance with order under the SARFAESIA Act.
The revision petitioner is required to approach the DRT only.
The revision petitioner herself stated that the respondent No.1 mis represented the facts and suppressed the material  9 Crl.R.P.No.387/2022 facts before the DRT.
